elaine-support: Escalation: multiple customers reporting p95/p99 spikes for text-generation v2 in us-west-2 since ~09:40 UTC. Several 504s and timeouts. Tickets C-1224/C-1226. Attaching quick repro and sample logs below.

samir-oncall: On it — can you paste the exact model + route + a minimal repro? Any deploys or infra changes in the last 30m? :eyes: 

elaine-support: Repro (minimal): POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>, Content-Type: application/json
Body: {"model":"text-gen-v2","prompt":"Summarize: ...","max_tokens":256}
Route: /v1/generate/tx-v2
Client: acct-8843
Recent deploy: yes, small runtime kernel tweak by tariq ~09:35 UTC (ops-bot shows deploy). Logs:

```
[09:41:02] request_id=xyz service=runtime instance=gpu-34 latency_ms=3500 status=504
[09:41:03] request_id=abc service=runtime instance=gpu-34 queue_ms=1200 model=text-gen-v2
[09:41:05] error=\"kv-cache miss\" model=text-gen-v2 instance=gpu-34
```

ops-bot: deploy: text-gen-v2@2026-03-17T09:35:12Z -> us-west-2 by tariq-eng

michaela-sre: Confirming metrics: p95 jumped from ~220ms -> ~1.2s; p99 around 3.6s. GPU pool-34 queue length spiked. I also see increased kernel syscalls on those instances.

samir-oncall: Proposed immediate mitigations (order):
1) Apply tenant-level rate cap on /v1/generate/tx-v2 for affected customers (soft cap 50 rps)
2) Enable circuit breaker: fail-fast when rolling p99 > 2000ms (return fast 503 + header X-Fallback-Used)
3) Route non-critical traffic to fallback model redwood-mini-quant in us-east-1
4) If latency persists, rollback kernel tweak on pool-34

samir-oncall: Quick CLI to push rate-limit + circuit-breaker (running now):
```
rictl policies apply --route \"/v1/generate/tx-v2\" \
  --policy '{"rate_limit":{"per_tenant_rps":50},"circuit_breaker":{"p99_ms":2000,"error_threshold":0.05,"action":"fallback"}}'
```

michaela-sre: I'm applying fallback mapping and promoting redwood-mini-quant as the auto-fallback. Command: 
```
rictl routes update --route \"/v1/generate/tx-v2\" --fallback \"redwood-mini-quant:us-east-1\"
```

deploy-bot: policy-update: policies/tx-v2-ratecap by michaela-sre at 1945679140

samir-oncall: Rate caps + circuit breaker enabled. Also temporarily set routing policy to prefer us-east-1 for acct-8843 and other impacted tenants. Watching metrics (p95/p99) and queue length. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

oncall-bot: Alert: route=/v1/generate/tx-v2 suppressed for 15m while mitigation active (suppress_id=sb-1945)

michaela-sre: Observing immediate improvement: p95 dropped to ~320ms after fallback routing for most traffic; p99 trending down from 3.6s -> ~900ms. Queue length on pool-34 decreasing.

samir-oncall: Next steps (short):
- Keep rate cap and CB active for 2 hours, then slowly relax while monitoring error budget.
- Run post-mortem: check kernel change diff and KV-cache warmup behavior.
- Prep permanent guardrail: per-route CB + fallback model + cross-region routing policy for critical tenants.

elaine-support: Confirmed with customers: latency improved for impacted users. They’re OK with temporary reroute; will leave tickets open for RCA and follow-up.

michaela-sre: I'll schedule rollback test of the kernel tweak in a canary group and run a short latency sweep. If that reproduces, we roll back and bake a mitigation into the deployment pipeline.

tariq-eng: Noted — I'll help triage the kernel change. If rollback is required, will coordinate a canary revert and post a deploy.

elaine-support: Thanks team — keeping this thread pinned to the escalation. Will update tickets when RCA is ready. :white_check_mark:
